
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the Z-test alternative hypothesis string associated with a Z-test
    alternative hypothesis enumeration constant.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: integer
        Alternative hypothesis enumeration constant.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Alternative hypothesis string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var str = 'two-sided';
    > var v = {{alias:@stdlib/stats/base/ztest/alternative-str2enum}}( str );
    > var out = {{alias}}( v )
    'two-sided'

    See Also
    --------
